last_amend_reason:
ESC-031 standing class esc-031-evidence-restatement, first use. tickets.json status_evidence FIELD ONLY, 64 tickets.

STRUCTURAL PROOF, not by eye: both versions parsed (HEAD's blob vs the file on disk), top-level envelope compared (version, project, full_verify all identical), ticket COUNT identical at 326, ticket ORDER identical, id SET identical (none added, none removed), every ticket's field SET compared, and every field of every ticket compared one by one. The set of fields that moved ANYWHERE in the document is exactly ['status_evidence']. status, verify, scope, acceptance and depends_on were each additionally asserted identical across all 326 tickets by name. git diff is 64 insertions / 64 deletions. tickets.json round-trips EXACTLY as json.dumps(obj, indent=2) + newline, verified against this file both before the edit and re-read from disk after the write -- and NOT assumed from the sibling protected file, because .swarm-loop/amend-classes.json does NOT round-trip that way (its 'fields' arrays are hand-inlined) and amendment 43 had to be applied textually for that reason.

THE BINDING CONDITION IS ENFORCED MECHANICALLY, not merely honoured: the applier asserts 'measured at 4b0eddf:' appears in all 64 restatements before writing a byte, and every restatement additionally carries the superseded string VERBATIM after it, so nothing in the ledger is destroyed -- the old claim is preserved, demoted from present-tense fact to quoted history. Also asserted after the write: all 64 still carry the stamp on re-read.

WHY, re-measured at 4b0eddf rather than taken from the survey that prompted this (restating on a stale survey is the same defect with a new date). Three shapes:
  A. 23 tickets asserted a path 'does not exist' or 'is a 0-byte __init__.py' where git ls-tree shows real code. Measured: services/ingest/src/er 6 files/66741B; apps/exchange/src/ranking 11 files/156408B; apps/merchant/svc/src/codes 10 files/113918B; apps/buyer/svc/src/intent 9 files/152416B; pixel/src 5 TS modules where the ticket says '0 files'; services/sim and apps/seller-reference both carrying real test files where the ticket says the gate 'passes VACUOUSLY on the scaffold'. Eleven named verify paths that 'do not exist' are files of 286-1472 lines.
  B. 34 asserted a path 'untouched since <sha>' or 'no commit names it'. Measured: apps/exchange/src/accept has 32 commits since e0ffd1a (T-157/T-158/T-169 all say zero); 28 commits name T-158, 20 name T-156, 11 name T-161, 17 name T-215; and five 'nothing landed after it' claims sit over 673-694 commits.
  C. 7 cited LINE NUMBERS that have drifted onto the comment DESCRIBING THE REPAIR, which is the sharpest shape because the evidence then reads as confirmation of the defect while quoting its fix. T-220's cited :492 is the comment saying the values it calls missing were APPENDED ('with 65, 128, 256 appended (T-220)'), the live _DEPTHS at :506 being [1,11,13,14,64,65,128,256]. T-166's cited :1174 is a docstring headed '*What the removed arm encoded*'. T-154's cited line 42 is prose reading 'This used to read app ... the shipped writer resolves trust_rw', the live EVENTS_ROLE at :54 being 'trust_rw'. T-209's cited :523 is a Mapping check, with :667 a comment recording that the cited statement WAS removed. T-157/T-202 cite :389/:390, both module-docstring prose.

WHAT WAS DELIBERATELY NOT DONE. No status moved, in either direction -- that is esc-029's field and esc-029 permits only closed->open on a reproducing defect; asserting 'therefore fixed' is a closure and closure is the gate's to grant. Accordingly ~30 of the 64 restatements say NOT DETERMINED in the evidence itself rather than guess: correcting 'the file is untouched' to '5 commits touched it' does not establish that the finding is discharged, and saying so is the honest stop. Six entries that were re-measured and found ACCURATE were left byte-identical: T-085, T-086, T-087 (docs/tests/test_runbook.py and e2e/test_onboarding.py genuinely have no blob at this head), T-130, T-134 and T-208 (fixtures/manifest.json observation_weights is byte-identical between 05cf86c and HEAD -- seven keys, mismatch_return 1.5).

TWO ENTRIES WERE RESTATED AGAINST THE BRIEF, and this is flagged rather than buried: T-083 and T-084 arrived on a hand-supplied 'accurate, do not touch' list. Measured instead of trusted: e2e/test_learning.py is 20268B/406L and e2e/test_dishonest.py is 24469B/511L at this head, both committed by 4b0eddf itself ('close(T-051,T-303b,T-084,T-083,T-024)'). Their 'verify path does not exist' claims are false, so the do-not-touch list was itself one survey stale -- which is exactly the failure this class exists to stop.

NO GATE MOVED AND NO BEHAVIOUR CHANGED. status_evidence is read by no code in the repo (git grep over *.py finds it only in two comments, apps/exchange/tests/test_repro_ledger_gates.py:782 and apps/trust/tests/test_repro_open_tickets.py:1086), which is exactly why a false green here cannot be caught by re-running the suite. The ticket-graph sweeps were run before and after and are unmoved: PROXYSHOP_WORKER=4 pytest proxyshop_support/tests/test_repro_open_tickets.py proxyshop_support/tests/test_repro_ticket_graph.py -q read '5 passed, 1 xfailed' at both ends, the xfail being T-262's live violator set, untouched by this edit.
